decision: Johannes: cap CMG's admission level assumption at 32 levels with a hard stop at the cap, a refusal test and a memory record; a public memory-control change outside the beta.9 qualification, landed as its own pin bump.

change.what: CmgOptions::default().max_levels 128 -> 32: hard construction stop (existing iterative MaximumLevels terminal, no new terminal reason) and level count of every pre-build CMG admission bound. fereg takes all CMG options from the default and has no level arithmetic of its own.
change.numerical_scope: none for hierarchies of at most 32 levels (bit-identical); admission and termination change at the cap

host.plugins: universal release builds with path remaps, arm64 slice used; base and head from the same recipe

admitted_cmg_bytes.method: CmgPreconditioner::construction_allocation_bound and scalar_workspace_allocation_bound with fereg's Schur options (low-effective-degree threshold 0, pruned/preserved/factored components) on the exact graph (vertices and edges from the explicit cmgschur trace with cmgsamples(1) cmgseed(0), whose hierarchy matches the Auto trace); before = 128 levels, after = 32

akm_short.retained_charge_note: two-FE OLS Auto keeps the serial construction bound charged as retained CMG storage, so its retained charge falls by the serial delta

unconstrained_fits.command: fereg y <controls>, absorb(worker firm) threads(T); FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1 FEREG_PHASE_TIMING=1
unconstrained_fits.fields: native_peak_est = e(fereg_memory) row 6; memory_bytes = routing_action trace; cells_peak = FEREG_CELLS attempt peak_bytes; solver = e(fereg_solver)[1, requested used iterations]
unconstrained_fits.base_vs_head: every listed field, the hierarchy trace, e(b)[1,1] (all digits) and every e(fereg_memory) row except safety_headroom are identical between base and head in all four cases; only host-dependent available-memory, RSS and timing rows differ
unconstrained_fits.observation: the reported peaks are identical whether CMG is installed or refused (see memory_limit_case), so they do not contain the CMG admission stage; the cap changes admission, not these reported envelopes. Not investigated further here.

memory_limit_case.control: FEREG_MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES (developer instrumentation; the public memory() option takes auto|fast|low and has no byte limit); usable = L - max(512 MiB, L/5)
memory_limit_case.note: head refuses below its own threshold (L 1037000000: solver [1, 4, 52]); at L 875000000 head fails with r(909) before any CMG attempt

validation.cmg: fmt, clippy, doc, all tests debug/release with and without all features (812 passed), release build; frozen_bits unchanged; hierarchy_admission bounds are derived, no re-derived expectations needed; new tests: 2 x 264-clique graph stops at 32 levels (34 unrestricted) inside its bound, first 31 levels identical, one byte short refuses without allocating; an explicit 128-level request is refused before allocating under the budget the default admits. The benchmarks manifest fails on its pre-existing workspace declaration.
validation.fereg_source_only: ./scripts/run_tests.sh --source-only passed (2106 Rust tests, 319 + 7 Python tests); installed-package checks not performed
validation.replay_vs_beta8: 70 exact; ols-09, ols-24, ols-27 differ only in the existing 2026-10-27 eager-cells scope paths (432, 2, 461 fields) and pass with it, as for the round-two parent
